headline: Sands China Earns Great Place To Work Certification™
summary: In recognition of its people-centric corporate culture and outstanding workplace environment, Sands China Ltd. has been awarded the Great Place To Work Certification™ upon its first participation in the assessment conducted by Great Place To Work™, a global authority on workplace culture. The company has become the first integrated tourism and leisure enterprise in Greater China to achieve this honour.
